# Replay Detection Evaluation

Replay uses a contiguous delayed window from the clean noisy synthetic measurement history: source k-20, samples 100:155, all 15 fourth-order channels, no interpolation. Intensity is the dimensionless blend in [0,1], not a physical percentage. Results below are from fixed SP-PF with 350 particles per partition and five seeds.
